scientific_integrity: The exact n-general characteristic-polynomial proof is included, together with a standard-library verifier using independently constructed integer Laplacian cofactors and characteristic determinants for n=5..8/5..7. The finite checks do not replace the displayed infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Counts only literal four-distinct-letter universal cycles over labeled alphabets of size n>=5, modulo rotation only. Does not count pattern-isomorphic or shortened cycles, or claim a general solution for other block lengths. An unindexed equivalent spectrum theorem remains a priority risk; independent expert verification has not been performed.
title: Explicit spectrum and count of four-permutation universal cycles
